title: Koschei's Troubles (miniquest)
start: Talk to Thorvald the Warrior in Skulgrimen's Battle Gear in Rellekka.

rewards.t: Antique lamp giving 30,000 experience in any skill of level 75 or higher.
An enhanced Balmung axe, depending on the colour of gem made:
Turning the jewel red will morph the Balmung into a Crimson Balmung.
Turning the jewel blue will morph the Balmung into a Cobalt Balmung.
Turning the jewel green will morph the Balmung into a Viridian Balmung.
Using the "Toggle-colour" option to turn it into an Achromatic Balmung.
You can change the colour of the jewel, and the Balmung, at any time by speaking to Kharshai.

steps.t: Talk to Thorvald the Warrior north of Rellekka inside Skulgrimen's Battle Gear. [Chat: Accept › 3 Does he need my help?]
Talk to Koschei the Deathless. [Chat: 1 Let's go fight it - together!]
With the Balmung in your inventory, chop down the Blossoming tree north-west of the bridge south of Rellekka.
Take the chest from tree stump.
Climb up the ladder and return to Rellekka.
Go to the well south-east of the longhall.
Use the toy ship on the well.
Interact with the jewel. [Chat: 1 Attempt to cut the jewel]

sub.t: For additional completion, talk to Kharshai. [Chat: 4 I want to talk about your identity crisis. › 3 About that jewel... › 1 May I have a look at the jewel?]
Interact blue jewel [Chat: 2 Attempt to crush the jewel] (Requires 90 Strength)
Talk to Kharshai. [Chat: 4 I want to talk about your identity crisis. › 3 Kharshai, have a look at the jewel.]
Talk to Kharshai again. [Chat: 4 I want to talk about your identity crisis. › 3 About that jewel... › 2 May I have a look at the jewel?]
Interact red jewel [Chat: 3 Attempt to detect any curses] (Requires 90 Prayer)
Talk to Kharshai. [Chat: 4 I want to talk about your identity crisis. › 3 Kharshai, have a look at the jewel.]
Repeat the steps once again but make a new memory instead (blue) and the miniquest will be completed
